W.note: Layers aura, sheen and sparks with four named curves and a duration slider, but the aura is clipped by overflow hidden and the hover frames show modest change on the primary.

X.note: Separate lift and glow curves with a delayed bloom give the most considered motion, but the invalid font shorthand drops button weight and size and the desktop layout leaves a large dead gap.

Y.note: The most usable of the four: unclipped halo, sensible in and out timings, disabled and touch paths handled, and a clean mobile layout, though the hover change reads as subtle.

Z.note: The conic aurora and shimmer feel the most dreamlike, but animating box-shadow, filter and a blurred rotating layer costs more to render than a site button should.
